blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Sales and Operations Planning, or S&OP, is a regular meeting. It usually happens once a month. The sales team and the operations team sit together and agree on one plan. The sales team says what it expects to sell. The operations team says what it can deliver. Together, they find the balance.

At Czarnikow, this meeting connects the trading desks with logistics and supply chain. If the Brazil desk expects a large sugar order next month, the operations team needs to book vessels, check warehouse space and confirm supplier capacity.

Without this meeting, each team works with different numbers. A good plan is simple: one forecast, one plan, one set of numbers that everyone trusts.

items.q: How often does the S&OP meeting usually happen?
items.why: "It usually happens once a month."

items.q: In the meeting, what does the operations team say?
items.why: "The operations team says what it can deliver."

items.q: What must the operations team do if the Brazil desk expects a large sugar order?
options: Book vessels and check warehouse space
items.why: "the operations team needs to book vessels, check warehouse space and confirm supplier capacity."

items.q: The text suggests that without this meeting, the teams would most likely…
options: disagree because they use different numbers
items.why: Inferência: "each team works with different numbers" — números diferentes levam a conflito.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that a good plan is…
options: made by the sales team alone
simple, with one set of numbers everyone trusts
items.why: Inferência: "A good plan is simple: one forecast, one plan, one set of numbers that everyone trusts."

blocks.instruction: Ouça James preparando a reunião de S&OP. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, next Tuesday I am chairing the S&OP meeting, so today I am pulling everything into one slide.

Right now I am looking at three numbers. First, the sales forecast: the Brazil desk is expecting a big sugar order next month. Second, our capacity: I am checking with logistics if we have enough vessels and warehouse space. Third, the finance view: I am adding the cost and the margin, so everyone sees the same picture.

The goal is simple. I want one plan and one set of numbers. When sales, operations and finance all use the same slide, we stop arguing about whose numbers are correct.

I am keeping the meeting short. We have one hour, no more. I am not turning this into a long, bureaucratic session. S&OP is a powerful tool, but only if we stay focused and finish on time.

So please, come ready. Read the slide before Tuesday, and bring your questions to the meeting.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is James doing today?
items.why: "today I am pulling everything into one slide."

items.q: Which three numbers is James looking at?
options: Sales forecast, capacity and finance view
items.why: "the sales forecast… our capacity… the finance view."

items.q: Why does James want one plan and one set of numbers?
options: So the teams stop arguing about whose numbers are correct
To please the finance team only
To sell more sugar in Brazil
items.why: "we stop arguing about whose numbers are correct."

items.q: James says the meeting will last one hour. This suggests that he…
options: will let the meeting run all day
does not care about the plan
wants the meeting to be short and focused
items.why: Inferência: "I am keeping the meeting short. We have one hour, no more."

items.q: When James asks people to read the slide before Tuesday, he most likely wants them to…
options: come prepared so the meeting stays on time
items.why: Inferência: "come ready. Read the slide before Tuesday" — para a reunião ser rápida e focada.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "S&OP stands for Sales and Operations Planning." S&OP is…
options: a planning meeting between sales and operations
items.why: S&OP = Sales and Operations Planning, a reunião de planejamento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Sales, operations and ___ all join the same meeting to check the cost."
items.why: Finance = finanças, o time que cuida do custo e da margem.

items.q: "We need one single plan, not five different ones." A single plan means…
items.why: One single plan = plano único, o mesmo para todos os times.

items.q: "Everyone must use the same version of the truth." This means…
options: an old plan from last year
the same, agreed set of numbers
items.why: Version of the truth = versão da verdade: os números que todos aceitam.

items.q: "S&OP is not bureaucratic; it is a powerful tool." Bureaucratic means…
items.why: Bureaucratic = burocrático: cheio de processos lentos e pesados.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de planejamento. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The finance team must sign off on the plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new plan next month." To roll out means to…
options: start using it, step by step
items.why: Roll out = implementar, colocar em prática aos poucos.

items.q: "The Brazil desk pushed back on the forecast." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "Let's sit down together and agree on one plan." To sit down together means to…
items.why: Sit down together = sentar juntos para conversar e decidir.

items.q: "Please come ready for Tuesday's meeting." To come ready means to…
items.why: Come ready = chegar preparado, com a lição de casa feita.
